description: Capability for the main window. Filesystem access exists for one feature: importing a PDF, .txt or .md the person already owns. Granted: dialog:allow-open (the file picker) and fs:allow-read-file, the latter scoped to $DOCUMENT/**, $DOWNLOAD/** and $DESKTOP/** — where a bought e-book or a lecture handout actually sits. Withheld deliberately: every write, create, copy, rename and remove command; every directory-listing command (read-dir/exists/stat), which would let the renderer enumerate someone's files without them picking any; dialog:allow-save; and $HOME/**, which would put dotfiles, keys and browser profiles in reach of a read this feature never needs.
